cat > /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/run_extended_val_sweep.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cls_8b_s42_resume"
EVAL_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results"
STEPS=(1800 2000 2200 2400 2600 2800 3000 3200 3400 3600 3800 4000 4200 4400 4600 4800 5000 5200)
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B/"
SUMMARY_FILE="${EVAL_BASE}/s42_extended_val_sweep_summary.json"

mkdir -p "${EVAL_BASE}"

echo "========== S42 Extended Val Sweep =========="
echo "Start time: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "Total checkpoints: ${#STEPS[@]}"
echo ""

# Initialize summary JSON
echo "{" > "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo '  "experiment": "s42_extended_val_sweep",' >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo "  \"start_time\": \"$(date -Iseconds)\"," >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo '  "results": {' >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"

FIRST=true
COMPLETED=0
SKIPPED=0

for STEP in "${STEPS[@]}"; do
    CKPT_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/checkpoint-${STEP}"
    OUT_DIR="${EVAL_BASE}/cls8b_s42_resume_ckpt${STEP}_val8192"

    echo "---------- checkpoint-${STEP} ----------"

    if [ ! -d "${CKPT_DIR}" ]; then
        echo "SKIP: ${CKPT_DIR} does not exist"
        SKIPPED=$((SKIPPED + 1))
        continue
    fi

    echo "Eval start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

    python3 eval_repo_cls.py \
        --checkpoint_dir "${CKPT_DIR}" \
        --model_name "${MODEL}" \
        --split val \
        --max_seq_length 8192 \
        --max_new_tokens 8 \
        --batch_size 1 \
        --device cuda:0 \
        --output_dir "${OUT_DIR}/"

    echo "Eval end: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

    # Read accuracy from results.json
    if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/results.json" ]; then
        ACC=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('${OUT_DIR}/results.json')); print(d.get('accuracy', d.get('acc', 'N/A')))")
        echo ">>> checkpoint-${STEP} accuracy: ${ACC}"
    else
        ACC="NO_RESULTS_FILE"
        echo ">>> checkpoint-${STEP}: results.json not found"
    fi

    # Append to summary JSON
    if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then
        FIRST=false
    else
        echo "," >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
    fi
    printf '    "%s": %s' "${STEP}" "${ACC}" >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"

    COMPLETED=$((COMPLETED + 1))
done

echo "" >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo "  }," >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo "  \"end_time\": \"$(date -Iseconds)\"," >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo "  \"completed\": ${COMPLETED}," >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo "  \"skipped\": ${SKIPPED}" >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
echo "}" >> "${SUMMARY_FILE}"

echo ""
echo "========== Sweep Complete =========="
echo "End time: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "Completed: ${COMPLETED}, Skipped: ${SKIPPED}"
echo "Summary: ${SUMMARY_FILE}"
cat "${SUMMARY_FILE}"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/run_extended_val_sweep.sh
echo "SCRIPT_CREATED_OK"
